hints.title: Ascending Divisor Exploration
hints.text: To avoid duplicate factor permutations, enforce that every newly chosen divisor is greater than or equal to the preceding divisor.

hints.title: Square Root Boundary Search
hints.text: Only test factors up to the integer square root of the remaining value. Any valid factor immediately yields a companion quotient.

hints.title: Backtracking with Quotient Append
hints.text: Start divisor at 2. If current path is non-empty, record path plus remainder as a combination. Iterate d from start while d * d <= remainder, branching on remain % d == 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal recursive exploration bounded by total factor partitions with recursion depth at most O(log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered factorization produces redundant permutations of the same multiset of factors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Non-decreasing divisor constraint eliminates permutations without hashing sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid including the trivial single-element factorization [n] in the answer.
